name: @lmthing/dsh-pod-server
description: Production compute-pod entrypoint (Part B1, see dsh/PROGRESS.md): binds 0.0.0.0 for the K8s Service/probe, spawns dsh bound to loopback only (dsh itself refuses --host 0.0.0.0 — see the module doc comment in src/index.js), reverse-proxies HTTP+WebSocket to it, and answers /api/health for the Deployment's startupProbe. Zero new npm dependencies: the HTTP/WS proxying is hand-rolled over node:http and node:net.
